note: Re-judged 2026-11-06 by an independent auditor who authored none of the changes named. RFC 7911 Section 2: "However, the Path Identifier MUST be assigned in such a way that the BGP speaker is able to use the (Prefix, Path Identifier) to uniquely identify a path advertised to a neighbor." 1e65b6d4bb changed two cited producers. adjOutWrite.allow gains a branch for sentForward.ownRouteWithdrawal, which only sendOwnRouteWithdrawal sets, for a stale-rail withdrawal with no sent receipt: it spares an absent key or another source's entry, and does not change how a key is built or an identifier assigned. writeUpdateBody now takes the receipt in a local and calls noteExportWrite, which can only raise the export watermark and writes nothing. Neither reaches the generator, and neither fires on the relay these units drive. Both tagged units are byte-identical and were re-read: TestForwardPathIDsDifferForCollidingSources reads the identifier field from two destination frames of colliding sources and requires them unequal; TestForwardPathIDStableAcrossUpdates requires a repeat of one path to keep its identifier and a colliding source to differ. Caveat on scope: both units drive buildFwdBody, so they judge identifiers on re-advertised paths and do not exercise identifiers on originated routes. No test or record ran for this rejudgment. Verdict unchanged: enforced.
